# Code of Conduct

## Our commitment

PinkieSysMon welcomes constructive technical discussion and contributions. Everyone participating in the project is expected to treat others with respect, regardless of background or experience.

## Expected behavior

- Discuss ideas, code, and evidence without attacking people.
- Be courteous when giving feedback or disagreeing.
- Keep conversations relevant and help resolve problems constructively.
- Respect others' privacy and do not disclose personal information without permission.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Harassment, intimidation, threats, or discriminatory remarks.
- Personal insults, targeted hostility, or repeated disruption of discussions.
- Publishing another person's private information without consent.

## Scope

This code of conduct applies to project interactions in GitHub Issues, Pull Requests, Discussions, and other project-managed collaboration spaces.

## Reporting and enforcement

For concerns that can be raised publicly, notify the repository maintainer [@Jim1537](https://github.com/Jim1537) in the relevant discussion. Do not publish sensitive details or private evidence in a public thread.

For abuse or concerns that should not be raised publicly, use [GitHub's abuse-reporting tools](https://docs.github.com/en/communities/maintaining-your-safety-on-github/reporting-abuse-or-spam).

The maintainer may moderate inappropriate content, close or lock discussions, or restrict participation when permitted by GitHub. Actions will depend on the severity and context of the behavior. GitHub's own policies also apply.
